messages:
Kayla: quick flag — the API reference for POST /v1/predict was migrated to batched inputs in the schema (inputs: [{text: string}]) but a bunch of our examples still use `prompt: \"...\"`. users are getting confused.
Sam: saw a support ticket about that earlier, thanks for surfacing. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Miguel: which repo/page? is this the api-ref or the model runbook?
Kayla: api-ref (rendered at /docs/api/predict). OpenAPI was updated but the hand-written curl/python/js/go snippets were not.
Priya: that would explain the SDK confusion. our python client handles both for now, but docs showing `prompt` is misleading and will cause copy-paste breakage.
Sam: proposal: replace canonical examples with `inputs: [{text: \"...\"}]` across curl/python/js/go, keep one legacy example that uses `prompt` and a deprecation callout linking to the migration guide.
Miguel: +1. also need to add an SSE streaming example that demonstrates how to stream multiple batched prompts in one connection — current EventSource snippet assumes a single string.
Kayla: good call. can we add a tiny Go example showing a batch request? the current Go snippet only demonstrates a single string. show an Inputs struct with json tags so its explicit.
Priya: I can draft the Go snippet and a small SSE parser that accumulates partial token arrays.
Tim: reminder: docs linter will fail if we change examples but forget to run tools/docs-gen to regenerate OpenAPI-derived samples. ensure the PR runs the docs-gen job.
Kayla: agreed. checklist I propose: 1) update OpenAPI example payloads in openapi.yaml 2) run tools/docs-gen to refresh generated examples 3) update manual snippets (curl, py, js, go) 4) add a migration note + short TL;DR 5) update SDK README snippets 6) add entry to internal migration tracker and SDK changelog.
Miguel: I'll open a WIP PR with all the edits and the migration note. PR link: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4217 (WIP).
Sam: pinging @devex for review once its ready. devex team — can you sanity-check the SSE example shape? current fetch/EventSource snippet doesnt show JSON parsing for `data:` chunks.
Priya: adding SSE draft that parses each SSE chunk into JSON: `const payload = JSON.parse(event.data)` and handles `payload.partial_tokens` vs `payload.final`. also will show how to stream multiple inputs by sending an initial framing object.
Kayla: Miguel — please include a short migration section titled "prompt -> inputs migration" with curl+python examples and an example migration script for bulk-updating stored prompts.
Miguel: done in draft. I also added a small unit test that checks the rendered code block snapshot so we don't accidentally regress the formatting.
Tim: also add an entry to the SDK release notes recommending we accept both shapes for one minor release, then warn in the next. that will reduce breakage for customers who upgrade SDKs late.
Priya: will add the SDK changelog blurb. also suggest we add a one-line compatibility hint in the API page: "Both `prompt` and `inputs` are accepted until YYYY-MM-DD".
Sam: SGTM. once CI passes we can merge and publish.
docs-bot: preview available at https://deploy-preview-4217--docs.redwood.ai — note: preview currently shows mixed examples until docs-gen runs.
Kayla: PR checklist in the PR description: - update openapi.yaml examples - run tools/docs-gen and commit generated artifacts - update curl/python/js/go examples - SSE example + parsing snippet - migration note + deprecation timeline - update SDK examples and changelog - internal ticket for product updates
Miguel: tagging reviewers: @Sam @Priya @Tim @DevEx. please try to review by EOD Thursday.
Sam: will take a pass tomorrow morning.
Priya: pushed Go snippet draft to the PR with `type Inputs struct { Text string `json:\"text\"` }` and a batch example showing `[]Inputs`. left a short comment about naming and json tags.
Kayla: perfect. once merged we should post a short blurb in #product-updates and add a Migration note to the release notes.
Sam: thanks all — this should cut down the tickets.
